summary.headline: Hecto Financial to buy back KRW 2.3bn of its own common shares, Nov 24, 2026 to Feb 23, 2027
summary.what_happened: On Nov 23, 2026, Hecto Financial Co., Ltd. resolved to acquire up to 139,707 of its common shares through direct purchases on the KOSDAQ market, with Shinhan Investment Corp. as the brokerage. The buyback is planned to run from Nov 24, 2026 to Feb 23, 2027, and the company states its purpose as enhancing shareholder value and employee compensation.

key_numbers.label: Treasury shares held before this decision

summary.why_it_matters: Share buybacks in Korea are generally announced to return value to shareholders or to fund employee compensation, and they reduce the number of shares available in the market if the repurchased shares are later cancelled. The actual number of shares and amount acquired may differ from the plan depending on price movements and market conditions.
